clues.title: Client Scope Creep Detector & Polite Change-Order Generator
clues.quote: Client hired me for a landing page: $2,000 for 20 hours of work (my rate is $100/hr). Then the extras started: 'Can you add a blog section?' (+10 hours), 'Actually let's change the entire color scheme' (+8 hours), 'One more revision on the copy' (+5 hours). I kept saying yes because I didn't want to lose the client... Final tally: 43 hours worked, $2,000 paid. That's $2,300 in unpaid work.
clues.persona_context: Freelance web developer managing client revision requests over email and chat
clues.input_data: Signed project scope/contract PDF + incoming client email or message
clues.output_data: Out-of-scope flag + polite change-order quote draft + one-click payment link
clues.horizontal_segment: Fixed-price freelance web developers and UI/UX designers
clues.vertical_trigger_moment: The moment a client replies with 'just one quick addition' after initial milestone sign-off

clues.title: Multi-Source Activity to Invoice Synthesizer
clues.quote: I've been freelancing for a few years now (mostly full stack), and every month I waste a couple hours just trying to piece together timesheets -> invoices -> payments.
clues.persona_context: Full-stack freelancer billing hourly across multiple client repositories
clues.input_data: Git commit logs, calendar events, and time-tracker exports
clues.output_data: Client-grouped line-item invoice PDF + payment tracking dashboard
clues.horizontal_segment: Hourly full-stack freelance engineers with 2-5 concurrent clients
clues.vertical_trigger_moment: Last Friday of the month when assembling billable hours across GitHub, Slack, and calendars

clues.title: Scanned Bank Statement & Receipt PDF to Balanced CSV Converter
clues.quote: Are your bank statement PDFs scanned, messy, or unable to import cleanly into your accounting software? I will accurately transcribe and format your bank statements into clean, balanced Excel or CSV sheets.
clues.persona_context: Freelancers and bookkeepers preparing quarterly tax filings from messy PDFs
clues.input_data: Scanned PDF bank statements and photographed expense receipts
clues.output_data: Reconciled, balance-checked CSV ready for QuickBooks or Xero import
clues.horizontal_segment: Solo freelancers and boutique bookkeepers handling messy PDF statements
clues.vertical_trigger_moment: Quarterly tax prep when scanned PDF statements fail QuickBooks CSV import
